title: LangGraph Long-Term Memory: A Practical Vector Store Setup
excerpt: A hands-on walkthrough of LangGraph's long-term memory Store API: InMemoryStore for dev, PostgresStore with pgvector for production, and the dimension lock-in error that will eventually bite you.
seo_title: LangGraph Long-Term Memory: A Practical Vector Store Setup
meta_description: Learn how to properly set up LangGraph long-term memory: InMemoryStore for local dev, PostgresStore with pgvector for real production workloads.
social_message:
My agent forgot everything between sessions. Then giving it memory broke in a brand-new way.

LangGraph's Store API gives agents real cross-session memory, but swap embedding models later and PostgresStore throws 'expected 1536 dimensions, not 384' on every write. Here's InMemoryStore vs PostgresStore with pgvector, tested end to end against a real Postgres database.

Read the full guide 👉 https://www.firstevolvenextscale.com/langgraph-long-term-memory/

images.title: LangGraph Long-Term Memory Architecture
images.alt: LangGraph long-term memory: a faded short-lived session feeding a persistent vector Store a new session recalls from.
images.description: An agent's session memory fading while a persistent vector Store keeps the same facts available to the next session, the core idea behind LangGraph long-term memory.

images.title: LangGraph Store Namespace and Key Structure
images.alt: LangGraph Store namespace and key structure holding a JSON memory document for long-term memory.
images.caption: A namespace, a key, and a JSON document: the three building blocks of every LangGraph Store entry.
images.description: Diagram of how LangGraph's Store organizes long-term memory into namespaces, keys, and JSON documents.

images.title: Semantic Search Over LangGraph Memories
images.alt: Semantic search over LangGraph long-term memory: a query vector matched to the closest stored memories by score.
images.caption: A search query matched against stored memories by vector similarity, not exact keys.
images.description: Illustration of semantic search in LangGraph's Store, where a query vector is ranked against stored memory vectors by similarity score.

images.title: PostgresStore Dimension Mismatch Error
images.alt: LangGraph PostgresStore dimension mismatch: a 1536-dim write succeeding against pgvector, a 384-dim write failing.
images.caption: Change embedding models without migrating, and PostgresStore rejects the write with a dimension mismatch error.
images.description: Comparison showing a 1536-dimension embedding write succeeding against a PostgresStore table while a 384-dimension write on the same table fails with a DataException.
